subject: AWS Marketplace listing — ROI messaging, hero claim, and co-sell demo slate
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-analytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Rep <mktplace-aws@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing hero + field demo plan

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our marketing lead wants to finalize the hero claim and a short set of usage scenarios for the AWS listing. Procurement is also pushing to confirm pricing footnotes (metering + free trial length) before we hit the private offer step.

High-level asks from Acme:
- Tighten the hero to a single measurable outcome for buyers (we suggested "reduce inference cost by 6x" but they'd like to see conservative phrasing)
- Three short usage stories for the listing (SaaS analytics, batch embedding, real-time alerts)
- A 20–30 min co-sell demo script we can rehearse with field (which AWS will join for the first two exec demos)
- Confirmation on trial configuration and billing footnote language so procurement signs off

Can you send a single-page copy/asset pack + a demo slate we can run with? We need this to share internally at Acme by end of week. I attached a rough slide from our PM for context.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Director of Partnerships, Acme Analytics

Attachments: Acme_PLM_HeroDraft.pptx (pptx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing hero + field demo plan

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the clear list. I've drafted a compact asset pack and a recommended demo slate — attached. Key decisions I took with the team:

Hero claim options (conservative plus measurable):
- Option A (recommended): "Cut production inference cost up to 6x with predictable latency"
- Option B (softer): "Lower inference cost while preserving output quality"

Why Option A: it keeps a quantifiable benefit for procurement/finance while hedging with "up to". If Acme wants absolute minimum guarantee language we can replace "up to" with "typically".

Short usage stories (3, one line each) included in the asset pack:
- SaaS product: "Power in-app summarization and alerts at 10ms median latency for critical dashboards."
- Batch embeddings: "Embed large nightly datasets with 70% lower per-embedding cost using batching + KV caching."
- Real-time alerts: "Drive anomaly triage with sub-second inference for streaming signals."

Co-sell / demo slate (20–30 min):
1) 5m — Value prop + ROI snapshot (Rachel)
2) 10m — Live demo: ingest sample dataset, show batching/quantization toggles and cost delta (Tessa)
3) 5m — Integration story + deployment options (Dedicated vs. Private) (Kim)
4) 5m — Q&A + next steps (all)

Trial / billing footnote suggestion: 14-day trial with metered token usage; include footnote: "Trial includes unlimited test tokens for 14 days; production metering applies on conversion. Dedicated pricing discounts available via private offer." I'll follow up with pricing language for procurement to review.

I've attached: Listing_HeroOptions_v3.png, CoSell_Demo_Slate_v2.pdf, Usage_Stories_short.docx.

Next steps: Please confirm which hero option Acme prefers and whether the demo slate works for the field team. If you want, we can schedule a 30-min rehearsal with AWS joining — propose Wed 10/27 10:00 PT.

Best,
Rachel
Senior Strategic Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear asks, Rachel. Quick notes from my side:

- Deployment bullets (for the listing):
  • Private deployment: single-tenant VPC or on-prem; recommended for regulated financial customers; setup window ~6–8 weeks for customer-managed network & KMS integration.
  • Dedicated pool: reserved GPU capacity with SLA-backed latency targets; fastest path to scale, setup within 2–3 weeks.

- Hero: I prefer Option A with "up to 6x" but add an evidence link to the performance evals in the listing footnotes. That addresses procurement concerns.

- Demo: Tessa — include a short pre-recorded failover clip (30s) showing fallback to smaller model variant; reassures ops and procurement on reliability.

Priyom — on discounts: 15% / 25% for first-year committed private offer tiers looks reasonable. Add a short clause: "Discount applies to committed capacity only; standard overage pricing applies otherwise."

I'll approve the asset pack once the footnote to performance evals is linked and Priyom adds the invoice/PO wording.

Kim

Redwood Inference
